raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Follow-up to #49445. Admission limits reject requests with HTTP 503, but operators cannot tell from metrics which queue cap fired (`max_num_queued_reqs` vs `max_num_queued_tokens`), and each rejection logged at INFO.

This adds `vllm:admission_rejections_total` (`reason` label, no `engine` label). The unit is one rejected frontend admission attempt; `n > 1` still increments by one. The counter is incremented in `check_admission` through `StatLoggerManager`, matching the sleep-state side door: this event never appears in `EngineCoreOutputs`.

Per-rejection diagnostic messages move from INFO to DEBUG now that the counter exists (requested on #49445 until metrics landed).

Not duplicating:
- #53936 (atomic `n > 1` admission) remains a separate core change.
- #54746 (shared occupancy) is a different feature.
- No other open PR implements `admission_rejections`.

## Test Plan

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v1/engine/test_admission_control.py
```

Existing admission tests now also assert Prometheus samples (success stays at 0, each reject reason increments once, request-cap-first, `n > 1` still +1). `vllm:admission_rejections_total` is listed in `EXPECTED_METRICS_V1`.

## Test Result

```
46 passed, 14 warnings in 4.71s
```

No model evaluation: metrics and logging only; admission decisions are unchanged.

AI assistance was used to draft this change. I reviewed every line and ran the tests above.

cc @NickLucche

files.patch:
@@ -30,6 +30,7 @@ In v1, an extensive set of metrics are exposed via a Prometheus-compatible `/met
 - `vllm:prompt_tokens_total` (Counter) - Total number of prompt tokens processed.
 - `vllm:generation_tokens_total` (Counter) - Total number of generated tokens.
 - `vllm:request_success_total` (Counter) - Number of finished requests (by finish reason).
+- `vllm:admission_rejections_total` (Counter) - Admission attempts rejected by a queue limit, by reason.
 - `vllm:request_prompt_tokens` (Histogram) - Histogram of input prompt token counts.
 - `vllm:request_generation_tokens` (Histogram) - Histogram of generation token counts.
 - `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds` (Histogram) - Time to first token (TTFT).

@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@
 These tests cover:
 - OutputProcessor.get_num_queued_tokens() token counting
 - AsyncLLM.check_admission() admission control logic
+- Admission rejection Prometheus samples
 - Exception classes (GracefulHTTPError, QueueOverflowError, MaxQueuedTokensError)
 - create_error_response() mapping GracefulHTTPError to HTTP 503
 - SchedulerConfig field defaults and validation

 from vllm.v1.engine.output_processor import OutputProcessor
+from vllm.v1.metrics.loggers import StatLoggerManager
+
+_ADMISSION_METRIC_MODEL = "admission-metric-test"
+_ADMISSION_LOGGER = "vllm.v1.engine.async_llm"
 
 pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
 
@@ -70,10 +77,43 @@ def _make_async_llm(
     llm.output_processor = MagicMock()
     llm.output_processor.get_num_unfinished_requests.return_value = num_unfinished
     llm.output_processor.get_num_queued_tokens.return_value = num_queued_tokens
+    llm.logger_manager = None
     llm.admission_stats = None
     return llm
 
 
+def _attach_prometheus_logger(
+    llm: AsyncLLM, engine_indexes: list[int] | None = None
+) -> None:
+    """Attach a real Prometheus logger manager to a lightweight AsyncLLM."""
+    vllm_config = MagicMock()
+    vllm_config.observability_config.show_hidden_metrics = False
+    vllm_config.observability_config.kv_cache_metrics = False
+    vllm_config.observability_config.custom_histogram_buckets = None
+    vllm_config.model_config.served_model_name = _ADMISSION_METRIC_MODEL
+    vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len = 2048
+    vllm_config.model_config.is_diffusion = False
+    vllm_config.speculative_config = None
+    vllm_config.kv_transfer_config = None
+    vllm_config.ec_transfer_config = None
+    vllm_config.lora_config = None
+    llm.logger_manager = StatLoggerManager(
+        vllm_config=vllm_config,
+        engine_idxs=engine_indexes,
+        enable_default_loggers=False,
+    )
+
+
+def _admission_rejection_count(reason: str) -> float:
+    """Read the Prometheus sample for one admission rejection reason."""
+    value = REGISTRY.get_sample_value(
+        "vllm:admission_rejections_total",
+        {"model_name": _ADMISSION_METRIC_MODEL, "reason": reason},
+    )
+    assert value is not None
+    return value
+
+

     op.request_states = request_states
